language.title: Welcome to Meeting Guard AI
language.subtitle: Let's set things up so you never miss a meeting again. First, choose your language.
language.hint: You can change it any time from the menu.

calendars.title: Connect your calendars
calendars.subtitle: Meeting Guard alerts you about the meetings in your calendars and keeps everything in sync.
calendars.later: You can change this later in Settings.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.description: Two-way sync: meetings you create here appear in Google Calendar, and your Google events get Meeting Guard alerts.
google.scopeDenied: Calendar access was not granted. You can connect it later in Settings.

device.title: Calendars on this device
device.description: Import events from the calendars on your phone, such as iCloud or Outlook accounts.
device.denied: Calendar access is off. You can turn it on in your device settings.
device.empty: No calendars were found on this device.
device.googleNote: Synced from Google: already covered by Google Calendar sync.

alerts.title: How should we alert you?
alerts.subtitle: Choose how hard Meeting Guard tries to get your attention before a meeting.

max.title: Maximum
max.description: Alarm sound and vibration. While the app is open it fills the screen, reads the alert aloud and waits for you to respond. When the app is closed or the phone is locked, it is a high-priority alarm notification.

medium.title: Medium
medium.description: A persistent banner with sound. You can minimize it, but it stays until you act.

light.title: Light
light.description: A short notification with a brief sound.

preview.label: Preview
preview.lightText: Weekly team sync starts in 5 minutes

times.label: Remind me
times.required: Choose at least one reminder time.

permission.title: Notifications
permission.description: Meeting Guard needs notifications to alert you, even when the app is closed.
permission.denied: Notifications are off. Turn them on in your device settings so alerts can reach you.
permission.provisional: Notifications are delivered quietly. Allow them fully in Settings to get sound and banners.

exactAlarms.title: Exact alarms (Android)
exactAlarms.description: Android can delay alerts unless Meeting Guard is allowed to use exact alarms. Turn on "Alarms & reminders" for Meeting Guard so alerts ring right on time.

timeSensitive.title: Time Sensitive alerts (iPhone)
timeSensitive.description: Meeting alerts are marked as Time Sensitive so they can break through Focus. If you use Focus, allow Time Sensitive notifications for Meeting Guard.

assistant.title: Meet your AI assistant
assistant.subtitle: Tell the assistant what you need in your own words, in English or Spanish.

capabilities.create: Create meetings from a single sentence
capabilities.share: Share meeting details with other people

assistant.confirm: The assistant never changes anything on its own: you always see a confirmation card first.

examples.create: Schedule a team standup tomorrow at 9 am with a Google Meet link
examples.move: Move my 4 pm meeting to 5 pm
examples.share: Send the marketing meeting link to john@company.com
examples.bulk: Push all my meetings tomorrow 30 minutes later

assistant.quota_one: Your {{plan}} plan includes {{count}} assistant request per day.
assistant.quota_other: Your {{plan}} plan includes {{count}} assistant requests per day.
assistant.privacy: Your messages, together with your upcoming meetings, are sent to our server and processed by OpenAI to understand your request.

firstMeeting.title: Create your first meeting
firstMeeting.subtitle: Pick the way that suits you. You can always use the other one later.

manual.title: Fill in a form
manual.description: Enter the title, date, time and alerts yourself.

ai.title: Ask the AI assistant
ai.description: Describe the meeting and the assistant prepares it for you to confirm.

firstMeeting.skip: Skip and go to my dashboard
firstMeeting.aiPrompt: Schedule a meeting with my team tomorrow at 10 am for 30 minutes
